name: Organoids and organ-on-chip testing
summary: Small human-derived tissue models reproduce selected aspects of organ biology for research and drug testing.
useCase: A drug developer compares liver toxicity or tumour response in a human tissue model before choosing which compounds to advance.
whyNow: Commercial platforms and regulatory interest in alternative methods have increased. FDA guidance supports validation in a defined context of use; it does not declare every organ model a replacement for animal testing.

mainstream.scope: Routine complementary use in selected pharmaceutical toxicity, disease-model and compound-selection workflows.
mainstream.rationale: Platforms already serve pharmaceutical researchers and policy supports better human-relevant evidence. Reproducibility, throughput and predictive validation remain necessary. Replacement of all animal studies and transplantation of complete organs are outside this forecast.

metric.name: Maximum parallel Organ-Chip samples per Emulate instrument run
metric.scope: Manufacturer specifications for successive Zoë-CM2 and AVA platforms; technical capacity proxy
metric.limitations: Technical capacity of two different instrument generations, not annual laboratory throughput, instrument shipments, actual utilisation or sector adoption. Different workflows and consumables mean the eightfold capacity increase is not an eightfold improvement in clinical prediction or market size.
metric.futureNote: No defensible like-for-like external forecast is available for this KPI. The forward maturity path is a separately labelled analyst scenario, not a numerical adoption forecast.
metric.growthLabel: Maximum parallel capacity rose from 12 to 96 samples per run; this measures enabling technology, not adoption.

milestones.text: Emulate launched Zoë-CM2 in November, supporting up to 12 Organ-Chips per instrument.
No comparable 2022 installed-base figure is included; model validation remained a key development task.
A December award announcement described more than 430 Emulate instruments placed globally; this is a separate installed-base indicator.
No comparable 2024 instrument-capacity or installed-base measurement is included; the gap remains visible.
Emulate launched AVA with capacity for up to 96 independent samples per run. FDA announced a roadmap to advance validated alternatives to animal testing.
FDA released draft guidance on validating alternatives in drug development in March; draft guidance is not blanket acceptance of every model.

tailwinds: Human-derived models can answer questions animal models miss
Drug developers need better early selection and toxicity evidence
bottlenecks: Incomplete immune, vascular and whole-body interactions
Predictive validity must be proven separately for each intended use
watchMetrics: Prospective prediction of clinical outcomes in defined contexts
Validated workflows accepted in actual regulatory submissions
Recurring consumable use, throughput and inter-laboratory reproducibility
